title: Slugify a Title
prompt: A blog editor needs URL-friendly titles. Write a function that lowercases the title, removes punctuation, trims extra spaces, and joins remaining words with hyphens.

explanation.beginner:
Example: slugifyTitle("Hello World Today") produces "hello-world-today". Map each explicitly supported state to its exact output text or value. Separate state selection from formatting.

Compare “removes punctuation”: input ["Build, Test, Ship!"] produces "build-test-ship". Explain which rule causes the difference before writing code.
explanation.junior:
Map each explicitly supported state to its exact output text or value. Separate state selection from formatting.

Tempting mistake: Capitalization, whitespace, and boolean-versus-string output are part of the contract; truthiness alone may combine distinct states.

The reference uses split, filter, join. Trace the intermediate value after each operation; count repeated scans inside callbacks separately when estimating cost.

Regression check: preserve the contract illustrated by “removes punctuation”, then change one boundary in a new test. The solution below is one implementation; another is valid when it preserves the same behavior.
